notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates - Beta 0.1.7
notes.notes:
Howdy All!

We have uploaded and released the latest build!

Feature improvements to Version 0.1.7:
o Added tutorial music
o Customized houses
o Added suspicion and warning notice when guards stop chasing you
o Added cupcake achievement
o Added a phone
o Added Freedom sound
o Updated letter creator
o Fixed minor image offset errors
o Added lamps to jail
o Other bug fixes

Once again thank you for all the work you put into testing for us! We couldn't do it without you. Keep it up and we will be ready for release soon!

Thank you for the support,
Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard

notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates - Beta 0.1.5
notes.notes:
Howdy All!

We have uploaded and released the latest build!

Feature improvements to Version 0.1.5:
o Updated letter editor to be able to gift books.
o Fixed guard and George book gifting
o Adjusted Isaac's starting position
o Fixed issue where ceilings and other pass-through objects would block clicks
o Removed duplicate banned activity listings
o Fixed issue where the Boom Box wouldn't play
o Various NPC AI fixes
o Added sleeping at night requirement back in
o Increased suspicion reduced by sleeping
o Doors can be exited without the key
o Guards no longer chase you forever
o Added icon to show when a guard is chasing you and when their losing you
o Fixed issue with multiple guards escorting the player to their home
o Various bug fixes in the tutorial
o Other small fixes

Once again thank you for all the work you put into testing for us! We couldn't do it without you. Keep it up and we will be ready for release soon!

Thank you for the support,
Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard

notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates - Beta!
notes.notes:
Howdy All!

We have uploaded and released the latest build!

Feature improvements to Version 0.1.1:
o Banned activities notification
o Letter delivery notification
o Letters added to inventory
o High suspicion music added
o Audio setup adjusted
o Fixed the ceiling issues with the admin and jail
o Books are now counted and listed in the inventory
o Letter creator now closes if player is escorted or moves away
o Fixed ceiling issues by rotating houses on the left side of the street
o Other small fixes

This is a past-due beta announcement! We've decided that the game is ready to move past the alpha stage and into beta. This was supposed to happen with update 0.0.6, but do to a communication failure nothing changed.

Once again thank you for all the work you put into testing for us! We couldn't do it without you. Keep it up and we will continue improving as time goes on.

Thank you for the support,
Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard

notes.title: Bugfixes and Updates!
notes.notes:
Howdy All!

We have uploaded and released the latest build!

Feature improvements to Version 0.0.4:
o  Rough Minimap
o  Intro screen updates on sound and pass through
o  Menu fixed
o  Name length limited
o  Finishing game takes you back to intro scene.
o  Wall graphic adjusted
o  Fixed Game Saving again
o  Added link to bug testing in the game.

These fixes were all made possible with your wonderful feedback! Keep it coming and we'll keep sending out improvements.

Joining our Discord is one of the best ways you can participate. The link is https://discord.gg/XYqrmUA93g  We had some great comments from testers this week, and we want more! :)

We're going to continue our Wednesday Twitch streams at 7:30pm to 8:30pm EST.
As usual we'll also have our scattered development workshops throughout the week with times posted in the Discord.

Thank you for everyone that's taking interest!
Airy the Dragon
DaDarkWizard
